owner_directive_verbatim_23:12Z: canon_ref = v5 SRR only, class column bounded hint (V1→golden-input, V2→scan, V5→injection) where the rule text already demands that shape; rule text governs; V7 rows authored from rule text, never from the column.

sfp_rows.Statement: | Assertion Floor | Subjects: any principal requesting a composed answer. Objects: the claim being composed. Operations: assert, compose, refuse. Rule: no sentence enters a composed answer without a per-sentence anchor to material; an unanchorable sentence is refused, not weakened (Doc 4 A2, A5.5). | | **SFP-2** | Certainty-to-Evidence Binding | Subjects: the Watch's response function (Mkono). Objects: severance authority. Operations: unlock, withhold. Rule: severance unlocks only from the closed six-signal registry; no confidence score, however high, is an eligible input (Doc 3 A5.2). | | **SFP-3** | Acceptance Floor | Subjects: any training run. Objects: model output. Operations: accept, refuse. Rule: every stated criterion satisfied or the run is refused in full; no partial acceptance (Promise #22, MOAC). | | **SFP-4** | Custody Floor | Subjects: any data crossing the chokepoint. Objects: the crossing itself. Operations: cross, de-identify, re-identify. Rule: no asset crosses without de-identification appropriate to its custody class (Promise #1, A5.1–A5.3). | | **SFP-5** | Non-Conformance Ceiling | Subjects: any actor whose behavioural signature drifts from its declared conduct. Objects: the actor's trust discount. Operations: reduce, revoke. Rule: loss of conformance alone returns an actor to baseline verification; it is never, by itself, grounds for conviction (Doc 3 A5.7). | | **SFP-6** | Release Budget | Subjects: all external parties, jointly and severally. Objects: the estate's total information release. Operations: release, refuse. Rule: total release across all parties, operations, and time is bounded; exceeding it is a floor violation, not a negotiable ceiling (DAP-35). | | **SFP-7** | Reproduction Ceiling | Subjects: any artefact or output leaving a component boundary. Objects: controlled-unit content. Operations: egress, refuse. Rule: no artefact or output passes carrying reproduction of a controlled unit above the ruled threshold (DAP-31, A5.15). |
